_comment: Verified 2026-09-19 against the SHA2-256 published at https://exiftool.org/checksums.txt. Note the host. exiftool.org keeps only the current release and now hands its downloads to SourceForge, so https://exiftool.org/exiftool-<version>_64.zip no longer exists, and the ordinary sourceforge.net/projects/.../download link returns an HTML interstitial rather than the archive - which would fail the hash check and tell the user their download was tampered with. master.dl.sourceforge.net is the direct-mirror form that actually serves the file. Published at https://paultechguy.github.io/Chronora/exiftool.json so a stale pin can be corrected in a commit rather than a release.
